content: ## Metadata_Start ## code: en ## title: Invoices ## slug: sales-documents ## seoTitle: ## description: ## contentType: Markdown ## Metadata_End There are two core objects: {{variable.Object_Invoice}} and {{variable.Object_LineItem}}. [Line Items](/v1/docs/line-items) work as a related object to the {{variable.Object_Invoice}}. You can send invoices to your customers for payment over the web using {{variable.Product_DocumentLink}}. ![DocumentLink Invoice](https://cdn.document360.io/f977eec0-500f-40a3-b663-724a51f78075/Images/Documentation/DocumentLink%20Example.png){height="" width=""} :::(Info) (New Field) The Invoice record has a new field called {{variable.Field_Invoice_DynamicFeeName}}. The field is populated *only* when an Invoice related to an Event with an associated tax Fee is created or updated. The field’s value will then be used in DocumentLink’s Invoice to override the Tax column’s label. Click [here](https://docs.blackthorn.io/docs/events-feature-about-fees){target=`_blank`} for more information about using Fees with Events. ::: ## Before Creating an Invoice Before you create {{variable.Object_Invoice}}, you should create a [Company Info](/v1/docs/company-info) record with your logo and company information and complete the Payments {{variable.Feature_PaymentsSetupWizard}}. 1. Complete the [Payments Setup Wizard](/v1/docs/quick-start) 2. Create a {{variable.Object_CompanyInfo}} record. (The address, name, and logo that you enter here are rendered on the {{variable.Object_Invoice}}.) 3. Create a {{variable.Product_DocumentLink}} Template record. Set the lookups to the {{variable.Object_PaymentGateway}} and {{variable.Object_CompanyInfo}}. When you create your {{variable.Object_Invoice}}, set the lookup to the {{variable.Field_Invoice_DocumentLinkTemp}} to default your {{variable.Object_Invoice}}'s configuration and merge fields. 4. Authorize {{variable.Product_DocumentLink}}. :::(Info) (Is the date format on your Invoice incorrect?) Check your browser's location setting. All date fields on an {{variable.Object_Invoice}} will reflect the appropriate date format based on your browser's location setting. ::: ## Invoice Calculations ### Gross Amount {{variable.Field_Invoice_GrossAmount}} (bt_stripe__Net_Amount__c): The sum or total amount across all {{variable.Object_LineItem}} records before anything is deducted. ### Discount {{variable.Field_Invoice_Discount}} (bt_stripe__Discount_Amount__c): The sum or total amount of all {{variable.Object_LineItem}} {{variable.Field_LineItem_Discount}} and {{variable.Object_LineItem}} {{variable.Field_LineItem_CodeDiscountAmt}} values for all related {{variable.Object_LineItem}}s. ### Net Amount {{variable.Field_Invoice_NetAmount}} (bt_stripe__Subtotal_Amount__c): * = {{variable.Object_Invoice}} {{variable.Field_Invoice_GrossAmount}} - {{variable.Object_Invoice}} {{variable.Field_Invoice_Discount}} OR * = the sum or total amount of all {{variable.Object_Invoice}} {{variable.Field_Invoice_NetAmount}} values for all related {{variable.Object_LineItem}}s ### Tax Amount (for Events only) {{variable.Field_Invoice_TaxAmount}} (bt_stripe__Tax_Amount__c): the sum or total amount of all {{variable.Object_Invoice}} {{variable.Field_Invoice_TaxAmount}} values for all related {{variable.Object_LineItem}}s. ### Fee Amount (for Events only) {{variable.Field_Invoice_FeeAmount}} (bt_stripe__Fee_Amount__c): * = the total amount due (without fees) * {{variable.Object_Event}} {{variable.Field_ETEvent_PaymentProcesFee}} OR * = the sum or total amount of all {{variable.Object_Invoice}} {{variable.Field_Invoice_FeeAmount}} values for all related {{variable.Object_LineItem}}s ### Total Amount {{variable.Field_Invoice_TotalAmount}} (bt_stripe__Total_Amount__c) = {{variable.Field_Invoice_NetAmount}} + {{variable.Field_Invoice_TaxAmount}} + {{variable.Field_Invoice_FeeAmount}} ## Create an Invoice 1. In the app launcher field, search for and click "Invoice" (the Blackthorn Custom Object, not the SF Standard Object). 2. Click {{variable.button_new}} in the top-right corner. 3. Select either the "Stripe Invoice" or "Invoice" record type. 4. Set the values for: - {{variable.Field_Invoice_Name}} The {{variable.Field_Invoice_Name}} field is automatically generated with an "INV" prefix and an ordered numeric string. For example, your first {{variable.Object_Invoice}} will be named "INV-1". This can be edited for any custom needs. This value will be rendered beneath the word "Invoice" on the {{variable.Product_DocumentLink}} document. This value is also written to the {{variable.Field_Transaction_Description}} field of the related {{variable.Object_Transaction}} record(s). - {{variable.Field_Invoice_Subject}} - {{variable.Field_Invoice_PONumber}} - {{variable.Field_Invoice_PaymentTerm}} - {{variable.Field_Invoice_DueDate}} - {{variable.Field_Invoice_PaymentGateway}} Defining the {{variable.Object_PaymentGateway}} tells the system which {{variable.Product_Stripe}} account the money should go to. - {{variable.Field_Invoice_EnabledPM}} Define how you would like to be paid for the {{variable.Object_Invoice}} - Card, ACH or both. Keep in mind that ACH transactions have a $5.00 capped fee which is an inexpensive fee compared to cards which have a percentage based fee. - {{variable.Field_Invoice_CompanyInfo}} - {{variable.Field_Invoice_DiscountCode}} If a discount {{variable.Object_Code}} has been created, define the record here. - {{variable.Field_Invoice_ContactBillTo}} The {{variable.Field_Invoice_Email}} and {{variable.Field_Invoice_Phone}} fields will automatically pull in the related Contact's email and phone values. - {{variable.Field_Invoice_AccountBillTo}} The address fields will automatically pull in the related {{variable.Object_Account}}'s billing address. - {{variable.Field_Invoice_AccountShipTo}} The address fields will automatically pull in the related {{variable.Object_Account}}'s shipping address. - {{variable.Field_Invoice_DocumentLinkTemp}} The {{variable.Product_DocumentLink}} fields will automatically pull in the related {{variable.Object_DocumentLinkTemplate}} fields. - {{variable.Field_Invoice_TaxAmount}} The {{variable.Field_Invoice_TaxAmount}} field can be manually defined to calculate the percentage of taxes you want added to a {{variable.Object_Transaction}}. - {{variable.Field_Invoice_WriteOffAmount}} If write-off Transactions are related, the {{variable.Field_Invoice_WriteOffAmount}} field is automatically populated. If there are no write-off Transactions present, then the field will be blank. 5. The {{variable.Field_Invoice_CurrencyISO}}, {{variable.Field_Invoice_Status}} and {{variable.Field_Invoice_PaymentStatus}} fields are automatically defined with default values. - {{variable.Field_Invoice_CurrencyISO}} = "USD" - {{variable.Field_Invoice_Status}} = "Draft" - {{variable.Field_Invoice_PaymentStatus}} = "Unpaid" *(only on Invoices)* 6. The {{variable.Field_Invoice_DocumentLink}} field is automatically generated with a random alphanumeric link. This link is used to render the {{variable.Object_Invoice}} online. 8. Click {{variable.Button_Save}}. ![H_01_11 Create an Invoice 1](https://cdn.document360.io/f977eec0-500f-40a3-b663-724a51f78075/Images/Documentation/H_01_11%20Create%20an%20Invoice%201.png){height="" width=""} 8. Click the {{variable.Field_Invoice_DocumentLink}} link. ![H_01_11 Create an Invoice 2](https://cdn.document360.io/f977eec0-500f-40a3-b663-724a51f78075/Images/Documentation/H_01_11%20Create%20an%20Invoice%202.png){height="" width=""} Once your {{variable.Object_Invoice}} is completed, you are ready to view the {{variable.Object_Invoice}} through the web-based and mobile responsive DocumentLink. ![H_01_11 Create an Invoice 3](https://cdn.document360.io/f977eec0-500f-40a3-b663-724a51f78075/Images/Documentation/H_01_11%20Create%20an%20Invoice%203.png){height="" width=""} :::(Info) (Additional Field Worth Noting) {{variable.Field_Invoice_AllocationRollup}}: Sum of all Allocations for this Invoice. ::: ## Auto-convert Opportunities to Invoices :::(Warning) (Add the Create Invoice Button) If the {{variable.Button_CreateInvoice}} button isn't already on the Opportunity page layout, you must add it before proceeding. ::: You can convert an existing {{variable.Object_Opportunity}} to an {{variable.Object_Invoice}} by clicking the {{variable.Button_CreateInvoice}} button. All {{variable.Object_Opportunity}} {{variable.Object_LineItem}}s will also be converted to {{variable.Object_LineItem}}s on the {{variable.Object_Invoice}}. The newly created {{variable.Object_Invoice}} will be linked to the original {{variable.Object_Opportunity}} via the {{variable.Object_Invoice}}'s {{variable.Field_Invoice_Opportunity}} lookup field. Since an {{variable.Object_Opportunity}} can be related to many {{variable.Object_Invoice}}s, the {{variable.Field_Invoice_Opportunity}} field is needed. The {{variable.Field_OpportunityProd_LineItem}} lookup field on the {{variable.Object_OpportunityProduct}} (OpportunityLineItem) facilitates mapping between the {{variable.Object_Invoice}}'s {{variable.Object_LineItem}} and the {{variable.Object_OpportunityProduct}}'s {{variable.Object_LineItem}}. This allows you to self-map additional {{variable.Object_OpportunityProduct}} {{variable.Object_LineItem}} fields, such as the custom tax field, to the {{variable.Object_Invoice}} using a process builder when an {{variable.Object_Invoice}} is created from an {{variable.Object_Opportunity}}. :::(Info) (Can I receive a notification when the Invoice's {{variable.Field_PTInvoice_Status}} changes?) Yes, you can. Create a process builder that notifies the record owner when the Invoice's {{variable.Field_PTInvoice_Status}} updates to accepted or rejected. ::: ## Invoice Payment Once the {{variable.Object_Transaction}} related to the {{variable.Object_Invoice}} has been captured (manually or with {{variable.Product_DocumentLink}}) and if the {{variable.Object_Invoice}} {{variable.Field_Invoice_BalanceDue}} = "0", then the related {{variable.Object_Invoice}} {{variable.Field_Invoice_PaymentStatus}} = "Paid", the {{variable.Field_Invoice_Status}} = "Completed", and {{variable.Field_Invoice_PaidInFull}} = the current date/time. ![H_01_11 invoice payment](https://cdn.document360.io/f977eec0-500f-40a3-b663-724a51f78075/Images/Documentation/H_01_11%20invoice%20payment.png){height="" width=""} ## Refunds Sometimes you need to refund an {{variable.Object_Invoice}}. A refund can be either a full or partial refund. Refunding part or all of an {{variable.Object_Invoice}} won’t trigger a change to the original {{variable.Object_Invoice}}. The {{variable.Object_Invoice}}’s {{variable.Field_Invoice_PaymentStatus}} will show "Paid" and the {{variable.Field_Invoice_BalancePaid}} will show the amount of the original {{variable.Object_Transaction}}. The Invoice’s {{variable.Field_Invoice_BalancePaid}} field is not changed after a refund occurs because refund & adjustment transactions are not considered in rollups. A new {{variable.Object_Transaction}} will be created with the {{variable.Field_Transaction_Amount}} equal to the refund amount, showing that part or all of the original {{variable.Object_Transaction}} was refunded. ![Invoice_Refunds](https://cdn.document360.io/f977eec0-500f-40a3-b663-724a51f78075/Images/Documentation/Invoice_Refunds.png){height="" width=""} ***Please be aware of the following functionality.*** If changes are made to the {{variable.Object_Invoice}} before the {{variable.Object_WebhookEvent}}s related to the refunded {{variable.Object_Transaction}} are processed, the {{variable.Object_Invoice}}'s {{variable.Field_Invoice_PaymentStatus}}, {{variable.Field_Invoice_BalancePaid}}, and {{variable.Field_Invoice_BalanceDue}} fields will revert to their original values. To avoid this, please make any manual adjustments to the {{variable.Object_Invoice}} record’s refunded {{variable.Object_LineItem}} after the {{variable.Object_WebhookEvent}}s related to the refund {{variable.Object_Transaction}} have been processed. The {{variable.Object_WebhookEvent}} processing job runs every five minutes, so the waiting time after refunding the {{variable.Object_Transaction}} is usually up to five minutes. You will be able to see the {{variable.Object_WebhookEvent}} records from the refunded {{variable.Object_Transaction}} on the {{variable.Object_Transaction}}’s {{variable.Object_WebhookEvent}}s {{variable.SFTerm_RelatedList}}. ### Rollup Fields The logic used for refunds on an {{variable.Object_Invoice}} also impacts the rollup fields in the {{variable.Object_Event}} record’s financial summary. If you want the {{variable.Object_Event}}’s {{variable.Field_ETEvent_BalancePaid}}, {{variable.Field_ETEvent_Gross}}, {{variable.Field_ETEvent_Net}}, and {{variable.Field_ETEvent_Total}} fields to be updated when a registered {{variable.Object_Attendee}} receives a full or partial refund, use the {{variable.CS_BlackthornPayTriggerSetting}} custom settings’ {{variable.CS_IncludeRefundsRollUpCalcula}} (Include_Refunds_in_Rollup_Calculations__c) field. The field is unchecked (disabled) by default. #### Full Refund If an Event Organizer checks the {{variable.CS_IncludeRefundsRollUpCalcula}} field and processes a full refund, the refunded {{variable.Object_Transaction}}s will be reflected on the {{variable.Object_Invoice}} record, and the {{variable.Object_Event}}’s {{variable.Field_ETEvent_BalancePaid}} field will be updated to “{{variable.Field_Transaction_Paid}} - {{variable.Field_Transaction_Refund}}” or zero. #### Partial Refund For partial refunds, the refunded {{variable.Object_Transaction}}s are reflected on the {{variable.Object_Invoice}} record, the related {{variable.Object_Event}}’s {{variable.Field_ETEvent_BalancePaid}} field is updated to “{{variable.Field_Transaction_Paid}} - {{variable.Field_Transaction_Refund}}”, and the {{variable.Field_ETEvent_Gross}}, {{variable.Field_ETEvent_Net}}, and {{variable.Field_ETEvent_Total}} fields are updated. #### Examples **Background:** An {{variable.Object_Attendee}} registers for a paid {{variable.Object_Event}} and pays the $100 due. An {{variable.Object_Invoice}} is then generated for the {{variable.Object_Transaction}}. **Scenario 1: Full Refunds/Custom Setting Enabled** The {{variable.CS_BlackthornPayTriggerSetting}}' {{variable.CS_IncludeRefundsRollUpCalcula}} field is checked (enabled), and a full refund is processed; the {{variable.Object_Event}}’s financial summaries will reflect a full refund. Ex. When an {{variable.Object_Attendee}} receives a full refund ($100), the {{variable.Object_Event}} record’s {{variable.Field_ETEvent_BalancePaid}} field will be updated to “0.” **Scenario 2: Partial Refund/Custom Setting Enabled** The {{variable.CS_BlackthornPayTriggerSetting}}' {{variable.CS_IncludeRefundsRollUpCalcula}} field is checked (enabled). When a partial refund is processed, the {{variable.Object_Event}}’s financial summaries will reflect a partial refund. Ex. When an {{variable.Object_Attendee}} receives a partial refund of $50, the {{variable.Object_Event}} record’s financial summary fields will update as follows. * The {{variable.Field_ETEvent_BalancePaid}} field will be updated to “$50.” * The {{variable.Field_ETEvent_Gross}} field will be updated to “$50.” * The {{variable.Field_ETEvent_Net}} field will be updated to “$50.” * The {{variable.Field_ETEvent_Total}} field will be updated to “$50.” **Scenario 3: Custom Setting *Disabled*** If the {{variable.CS_BlackthornPayTriggerSetting}} {{variable.CS_IncludeRefundsRollUpCalcula}} field is unchecked (disabled), and a full or partial refund is processed, the following will occur: * The {{variable.Object_Invoice}} will not be updated with new totals. * Only the initial payment {{variable.Object_Transaction}} amounts should be shown.
